blocks.en: Become familiar with the "seven pillars" framework of Good Distribution Practices (GDP)

blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Good Distribution Practices, GDP (優良配銷規範)：是確保藥品從製造廠到最終使用者手中，全程維持品質、完整性與療效的一套系統性規範。TR52 是 PDA 針對 GDP 所發布的指引性技術報告。
blocks.en: Good Distribution Practices, GDP: A systematic set of requirements that ensures a medicinal product maintains its quality, integrity and efficacy all the way from the manufacturing site to the final user. TR52 is the guidance-type technical report PDA has issued on GDP.

blocks.zh: Quality System (品質系統)：涵蓋組織架構、程序、流程與資源，用以實施品質管理的整體體系。在配銷環節中，品質系統必須延伸至倉儲、運輸及物流合作夥伴。
blocks.en: Quality System: The overall system of organizational structure, procedures, processes and resources used to implement quality management. In distribution, the quality system must extend to warehousing, transportation and logistics partners.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你訂了一個精緻的生日蛋糕。蛋糕師傅做得再好，如果外送途中被壓壞、放在太陽下曬了兩小時，到手時已經不能吃了。GDP 就像是「確保蛋糕安全送到你手上」的整套管理規範 -- 包括冷藏車的溫度控制、包裝防撞、路線規劃以及外送員的訓練。
blocks.en: Imagine you order a delicate birthday cake. However skilled the baker, if the cake is crushed in transit or left in the sun for two hours, it is inedible by the time it reaches you. GDP is the full set of controls that "gets the cake to you safely" -- temperature control in the refrigerated vehicle, protective packaging, route planning and training of the delivery staff.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TR52 明確指出本報告同時總結了法規要求（regulatory requirements）與業界最佳實務（industry best practices），但也提醒讀者需遵循各國當地法規。這代表 TR52 不是法規本身，而是一份「指引」（guidance），實際操作仍需對照各國 GDP 法規（如 EU GDP Guidelines、WHO GDP、FDA 21 CFR Part 211 等）。
blocks.en: TR52 states explicitly that the report summarizes both regulatory requirements and industry best practices, while reminding readers to follow their local regulations. In other words, TR52 is not a regulation itself but a "guidance"; actual operations still have to be checked against national GDP requirements (such as the EU GDP Guidelines, WHO GDP and FDA 21 CFR Part 211).

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼藥品製造完成後，仍然需要一套獨立的配銷品質系統？
blocks.en: Why is an independent distribution quality system still needed after a medicinal product has been manufactured?

blocks.zh: TR52 強調 quality、integrity 和 efficacy 三個關鍵字，試舉例說明配銷過程中哪些因素可能分別影響這三項？
blocks.en: TR52 stresses three key words: quality, integrity and efficacy. Give examples of which factors in distribution could affect each of the three.

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose and Scope 1.1 目的與範圍
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: Seven Pillars of GDP (GDP 七大支柱)：TR52 將優良配銷規範拆解為七大領域，形成一個完整的管理框架。前四大支柱由本報告涵蓋：
blocks.en: Seven Pillars of GDP: TR52 breaks Good Distribution Practices down into seven areas that together form a complete management framework. The first four pillars are covered by this report:

blocks.zh: Stability (穩定性)：確保產品在儲存與運輸期間不會因環境條件而劣化
blocks.en: Stability: Ensuring the product does not degrade through environmental conditions during storage and transportation

blocks.zh: Distribution Control Management (配銷管控管理)：涵蓋人員、場所、設備、物料處理、庫存管理、運輸等操作層面
blocks.en: Distribution Control Management: Covers operational aspects such as personnel, premises, equipment, material handling, inventory management and transportation

blocks.zh: Performance Management (績效管理)：透過異常管理、績效衡量、自我檢查及管理層審查來持續監控
blocks.en: Performance Management: Continuous monitoring through event (deviation) management, performance measurement, self-inspection and management review

blocks.zh: Supply Chain Partner Management (供應鏈夥伴管理)：涵蓋夥伴遴選、品質稽核、品質協議及業務審查會議
blocks.en: Supply Chain Partner Management: Covers partner selection, quality audits, quality agreements and business review meetings

blocks.zh: 其餘三大支柱（Qualification/Validation, Continuous Improvement, Import/Export Compliance）則規劃由其他 PDA 技術報告另行討論。
blocks.en: The remaining three pillars (Qualification/Validation, Continuous Improvement, and Import/Export Compliance) are planned to be addressed in other PDA technical reports.

blocks.zh: 可以把七大支柱想像成一棟建築物的七根承重柱。少了任何一根，整棟建築都有倒塌風險。每根柱子下面又有多個「子類別」，就像每根柱子需要不同的地基深度與鋼筋配置。TR52 先幫你蓋好前四根柱子的施工規範；其餘三根柱子的規範，則需要參考後續的技術報告。
blocks.en: Think of the seven pillars as seven load-bearing columns of a building. If any one is missing, the whole structure risks collapse. Each pillar also has several "subcategories", just as each column needs a different foundation depth and reinforcement. TR52 gives you the construction specifications for the first four columns; for the other three you will need to refer to later technical reports.

blocks.zh: Table 1.1 是整份 TR52 的「路線圖」，建議列印出來隨時對照，快速定位目前閱讀的內容屬於哪個支柱的哪個子類別。
blocks.en: Table 1.1 is the "road map" of the whole of TR52. Print it out and keep it at hand so you can quickly locate which subcategory of which pillar the text you are reading belongs to.

blocks.zh: 穩定性支柱的更詳細指引收錄在 PDA TR53，若需要深入瞭解配銷穩定性試驗設計，應一併參閱。
blocks.en: More detailed guidance on the Stability pillar is contained in PDA TR53; refer to it as well if you need to go deeper into the design of distribution stability studies.

blocks.zh: Distribution Control Management 支柱下有多達 9 個子類別，是七大支柱中最龐大的一個，反映出配銷操作的複雜性。
blocks.en: The Distribution Control Management pillar has as many as 9 subcategories, the largest of the seven pillars, which reflects the complexity of distribution operations.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 1.1 的結構設計值得注意：
blocks.en: The structure of Table 1.1 is worth noting:

blocks.zh: 綠色標示的前四支柱是本報告的範圍，灰色標示的後三支柱為未來報告的範圍
blocks.en: The first four pillars, marked in green, are within the scope of this report; the last three pillars, marked in grey, are for future reports

blocks.zh: 每個支柱底下的子類別數量不同，代表該領域的複雜度與廣度各異
blocks.en: The number of subcategories differs from pillar to pillar, indicating differences in the complexity and breadth of each area

blocks.zh: 從子類別的內容可以看出，GDP 涵蓋的範圍遠超出單純的「運輸」，包含人員訓練、設備確效、變更管控、退貨管理等全方位品質管理
blocks.en: The content of the subcategories shows that GDP goes far beyond simple "transportation"; it covers quality management in the broadest sense, including personnel training, equipment qualification, change control and returns management

blocks.zh: 在七大支柱中，哪一個支柱的子類別最多？這說明了什麼？
blocks.en: Which of the seven pillars has the most subcategories? What does this tell you?

blocks.zh: 如果你是一家 CDMO，你的客戶要求你說明自己在 GDP 方面的管理能力，你會如何利用這七大支柱的架構來組織你的回答？
blocks.en: If you were a CDMO and your client asked you to explain your GDP management capability, how would you use the seven-pillar framework to organize your answer?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PDA 將 Stability 獨立為一個支柱，而不是把它歸類在 Distribution Control Management 之下？
blocks.en: Why did PDA make Stability a separate pillar rather than placing it under Distribution Control Management?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Responsibility 1.2 職責
blocks.en: 1.2 Responsibility

blocks.zh: Marketing Authorization Holder, MAH (上市許可持有人)：依法規取得藥品上市許可的法人或自然人，對產品品質負有最終法律責任。
blocks.en: Marketing Authorization Holder, MAH: The legal or natural person that holds the marketing authorization for a medicinal product under the applicable regulations and bears ultimate legal responsibility for product quality.

blocks.zh: Third Party Logistics Service Provider, 3PL (第三方物流服務商)：代替製造商或 MAH 執行倉儲與物流服務的外部合作夥伴。雖然 3PL 實際操作產品，但品質責任仍由委託方共同承擔。
blocks.en: Third Party Logistics Service Provider, 3PL: An external partner that performs warehousing and logistics services on behalf of the manufacturer or MAH. Although the 3PL physically handles the product, responsibility for quality is still shared with the contracting party.

blocks.zh: Wholesale Distributors (批發經銷商)：在供應鏈中扮演中間商角色，從製造商購入產品再銷售給零售藥局或醫療機構。
blocks.en: Wholesale Distributors: Intermediaries in the supply chain that purchase product from manufacturers and sell it on to retail pharmacies or healthcare institutions.

blocks.zh: 藥品供應鏈就像一場接力賽：製造商是第一棒，3PL 是第二棒，批發商是第三棒，最後交棒給醫院或藥局。每一位選手（參與者）都必須遵守同樣的比賽規則（GDP），而且任何一棒掉棒（品質失控）都會導致整個隊伍失格（產品不合格）。重點是：沒有人可以說「這不是我的責任」。
blocks.en: The pharmaceutical supply chain is like a relay race: the manufacturer runs the first leg, the 3PL the second, the wholesaler the third, and the baton is finally handed to the hospital or pharmacy. Every runner (participant) must follow the same rules (GDP), and a dropped baton at any leg (loss of quality control) disqualifies the whole team (the product is non-conforming). The key point: no one can say "this is not my responsibility".

blocks.zh: 注意原文使用了「including, but not limited to」這個法律用語，表示所列舉的對象並非窮盡式列舉。這意味著即使你的角色不在列表中（例如：再包裝商 repackager、臨床試驗物流供應商 clinical logistics provider 等），只要涉及受管制產品的 handling、storage 或 transportation，同樣適用本指引。
blocks.en: Note that the original text uses the legal phrase "including, but not limited to", which means the list of parties is not exhaustive. Even if your role is not on the list (for example, a repackager or a clinical logistics provider), this guidance still applies whenever you are involved in the handling, storage or transportation of regulated products.

blocks.zh: 如果一家 3PL 在運輸途中發生溫度偏差，責任歸屬應如何劃分？製造商與 3PL 各應承擔什麼角色？
blocks.en: If a 3PL experiences a temperature excursion during transportation, how should responsibility be allocated? What role should the manufacturer and the 3PL each play?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 MAH 即使不直接處理產品，仍被列為 GDP 的責任方之一？
blocks.en: Why is the MAH still listed as a party responsible under GDP even if it does not handle the product directly?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary of Terms 2.0 術語表
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary of Terms

blocks.zh: 本詞彙表收錄了 GDP 領域中最常見的專有名詞。以下為幾個特別重要的術語解析：
blocks.en: This glossary collects the most common technical terms in the GDP field. A few especially important ones are explained below:

blocks.zh: CAPA (矯正與預防措施)：Corrective Action 處理的是「已經發生」的問題（矯正）；Preventive Action 處理的是「可能發生」的問題（預防）。兩者結合構成品質系統中最重要的持續改善機制之一。
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action): Corrective action deals with problems that have "already occurred" (correction); preventive action deals with problems that "could occur" (prevention). Together they form one of the most important continuous improvement mechanisms in a quality system.

blocks.zh: FEFO (先到期先出)：與一般倉儲的 FIFO（先進先出）不同，FEFO 以效期而非入庫時間為排序依據，確保接近到期的產品優先配銷，減少過期廢棄的風險。
blocks.en: FEFO (First Expired, First Out): Unlike the FIFO (first in, first out) used in general warehousing, FEFO sorts by expiry date rather than receipt date, so that product closest to expiry is distributed first, reducing the risk of expired stock being discarded.

blocks.zh: MKT (平均動力學溫度)：這是一個基於 Arrhenius 方程式計算出的「等效溫度」，用來評估產品在溫度波動環境下所承受的真實熱挑戰。MKT 並非簡單的算術平均溫度。
blocks.en: MKT (Mean Kinetic Temperature): An "equivalent temperature" calculated from the Arrhenius equation, used to evaluate the true thermal challenge a product experiences in an environment with fluctuating temperatures. MKT is not a simple arithmetic mean temperature.

blocks.zh: FEFO vs FIFO：想像你去超市買牛奶。FIFO 是店員把最早進貨的牛奶放前面；FEFO 則是把最快到期的牛奶放前面。對藥品而言，採用 FEFO 更合理，因為同一批次的藥品可能因為不同的運送路徑而有不同的剩餘效期。
blocks.en: FEFO vs FIFO: Imagine buying milk at a supermarket. With FIFO, the store clerk puts the earliest-received milk at the front; with FEFO, the milk that expires soonest goes at the front. For medicinal products FEFO makes more sense, because units from the same batch may have different remaining shelf life depending on the shipping route they took.

blocks.zh: MKT：假設你把巧克力放在車裡，早上 15°C、中午 40°C、傍晚 20°C。MKT 不是簡單取平均 25°C，而是考慮「高溫對巧克力的傷害程度遠大於低溫帶來的好處」，所以計算出的 MKT 會偏向高溫那一端。
blocks.en: MKT: Suppose you leave chocolate in a car: 15°C in the morning, 40°C at noon and 20°C in the evening. MKT is not the simple average of 25°C; it takes into account that "the damage caused by high temperature is far greater than the benefit of low temperature", so the calculated MKT leans toward the high-temperature end.

blocks.zh: 注意 LSP / 3PL（物流服務商）與 TSP（運輸服務商）的區別：LSP 可能只負責協調調度（不碰產品），而 TSP 實際承運產品。在品質協議中，兩者的責任範圍不同。
blocks.en: Note the difference between LSP / 3PL (logistics service provider) and TSP (transportation service provider): an LSP may only coordinate and schedule (without touching the product), whereas a TSP actually carries the product. In a quality agreement, their scopes of responsibility differ.

blocks.zh: VAWD 是美國特有的批發商認證制度，由各州藥學委員會協會（NABP）管理。若藥品有銷往美國的計畫，需確認經銷夥伴是否持有此認證。
blocks.en: VAWD (Verified-Accredited Wholesale Distributors) is a US-specific wholesaler accreditation program administered by the National Association of Boards of Pharmacy (NABP). If you plan to sell product in the US, confirm whether your distribution partner holds this accreditation.

blocks.zh: VMP (確效主計畫) 在配銷領域的應用包括：溫度監測器數量的合理性、再確效頻率等，不僅限於傳統的製程確效。
blocks.en: VMP (Validation Master Plan) applies in distribution to topics such as the justification of the number of temperature monitors and the requalification frequency, not just to traditional process validation.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) -- Arrhenius 方程式簡化形式：
blocks.en: Mean Kinetic Temperature (MKT) -- simplified form of the Arrhenius equation:

blocks.zh:
MKT = (ΔH/R) / { -ln [ (e^(-ΔH/RT1) + e^(-ΔH/RT2) + ... + e^(-ΔH/RTn)) / n ] }

其中：
  ΔH = 活化能 (activation energy), 通常取 83.144 kJ/mol
  R  = 氣體常數 = 8.314 J/(mol·K)
  T1, T2, ... Tn = 各時間點的絕對溫度 (K)
  n  = 溫度測量次數
blocks.en:
MKT = (ΔH/R) / { -ln [ (e^(-ΔH/RT1) + e^(-ΔH/RT2) + ... + e^(-ΔH/RTn)) / n ] }

Where:
  ΔH = activation energy, usually taken as 83.144 kJ/mol
  R  = gas constant = 8.314 J/(mol·K)
  T1, T2, ... Tn = absolute temperature at each time point (K)
  n  = number of temperature measurements

blocks.zh: MKT 的關鍵特性是：它永遠 ≥ 算術平均溫度，因為它加權考慮了高溫帶來的加速降解效應。
blocks.en: The key characteristic of MKT is that it is always ≥ the arithmetic mean temperature, because it gives extra weight to the accelerated degradation caused by high temperatures.

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，FEFO 與 FIFO 會產生不同的出貨順序？請舉一個具體的情境。
blocks.en: Under what circumstances would FEFO and FIFO produce different shipping orders? Give a concrete scenario.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 MKT 的計算結果總是高於或等於簡單的算術平均溫度？這對藥品配銷有什麼實務意義？
blocks.en: Why is the calculated MKT always greater than or equal to the simple arithmetic mean temperature? What is the practical significance for the distribution of medicinal products?

blocks.zh: LSP（物流服務商）與 TSP（運輸服務商）在品質協議中應承擔哪些不同的責任？
blocks.en: What different responsibilities should an LSP (logistics service provider) and a TSP (transportation service provider) each bear in a quality agreement?

blocks.zh: 一家台灣生技公司想將藥品出口至美國，在選擇美國當地的批發商時，VAWD 認證為何重要？
blocks.en: A Taiwanese biotech company wants to export its medicinal product to the US. Why is VAWD accreditation important when selecting a local US wholesaler?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: TR52 的定位：PDA 發布的 GDP 指引性技術報告，整合法規要求與業界最佳實務，適用於所有參與藥品配銷供應鏈的相關方。
blocks.en: Position of TR52: A guidance-type technical report on GDP published by PDA, integrating regulatory requirements and industry best practices and applicable to all parties involved in the pharmaceutical distribution supply chain.

blocks.zh: GDP 七大支柱：Stability、Distribution Control Management、Performance Management、Supply Chain Partner Management（本報告涵蓋）；Qualification/Validation、Continuous Improvement、Import/Export Compliance（後續報告涵蓋）。
blocks.en: Seven pillars of GDP: Stability, Distribution Control Management, Performance Management and Supply Chain Partner Management (covered in this report); Qualification/Validation, Continuous Improvement and Import/Export Compliance (covered in later reports).

blocks.zh: 責任範圍：GDP 適用於製造商、MAH、3PL、批發商、運輸承運商等所有涉及受管制產品 handling / storage / transportation 的參與者。
blocks.en: Scope of responsibility: GDP applies to manufacturers, MAHs, 3PLs, wholesalers, transport carriers and all other participants involved in the handling / storage / transportation of regulated products.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：CAPA、FEFO、MKT、VMP、VAWD 等為 GDP 領域的核心詞彙，須熟悉其定義與應用場景。
blocks.en: Key terms: CAPA, FEFO, MKT, VMP, VAWD and others are core vocabulary in the GDP field; you need to know their definitions and application scenarios.

blocks.zh: MKT 的重要性：基於 Arrhenius 方程式計算的等效溫度，是評估溫度偏差對產品影響的關鍵工具，其值永遠大於或等於算術平均溫度。
blocks.en: Importance of MKT: An equivalent temperature calculated from the Arrhenius equation and a key tool for evaluating the effect of temperature excursions on a product; its value is always greater than or equal to the arithmetic mean temperature.
